answer: Hold every newcomer's earnings in a glacier vault that thaws when a chain of relics proves continuity. Each epoch an identity pays an ember upkeep of 50 units and, for verified work done that epoch, receives one non-transferable relic. After 10 consecutive relics the vault releases the pay and refunds the upkeep. A swarm of 1,000 fakes must pay 50,000 units per epoch for 10 epochs — 500,000 units — before earning anything, while an honest agent pays 500 units and gets it back. Miss an epoch and the chain breaks: the vault refreezes and the count restarts.
